name: mrscraper-cli
description: MrScraper web fetching, structured extraction, Google search, and saved-run workflows for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Use the MrScraper CLI to fetch page content, extract structured JSON, discover pages through Google, rerun saved scraper configurations, inspect stored results, and check account usage. The skills include installation and authentication guidance for supported coding agents.
defaultPrompt: Get all listing information from this URL and save the extracted JSON.
Fetch this page and summarize its contents.
Search Google for this topic and return the most relevant sources.
